_comment: Annotated example for sentinel_connector.py --config. Microsoft Sentinel's real API needs an Azure AD OAuth2 client-credentials token exchange before any data call, and the data call itself is a KQL query against the Log Analytics workspace backing your Sentinel instance -- neither fits ingestion/polling.py's generic PollerConfig, so this uses the dedicated ingestion/sentinel_polling.py connector instead. Delete this _comment field (or leave it; it's ignored) before using.
name: sentinel-security-alerts
_comment_workspace: Sentinel -> Settings -> Workspace settings -> Workspace ID (a GUID, not a secret -- safe in this file).
_comment_auth: Register an app in Azure AD (Entra ID -> App registrations), grant it 'Log Analytics Reader' on the workspace (or the narrower 'Microsoft Sentinel Reader' role), and create a client secret. The three *_env fields name ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES holding the real Azure AD directory (tenant) ID and OAuth2 client credentials -- this file never contains a secret itself.
_comment_table: SecurityAlert (individual detections) rather than SecurityIncident (Sentinel's higher-level grouped case object) -- SecurityIncident doesn't carry raw IOC entities at all, and every other connector in this project normalizes discrete alerts, not pre-aggregated cases. See ingestion/normalizers.py:normalize_sentinel()'s own docstring for the full reasoning.
